breeds.name: 银渐层
breeds.coat: Silver shaded cat: luminous ivory-white fur with fine cool silver-gray tipping concentrated on crown, back and tail, smooth gradual transition to white muzzle chest belly and paws. No orange, no calico patches, NO tiger stripes, NO hard gray bands. Pink nose and inner ears, retain black eyes.

breeds.name: 棕虎斑
breeds.coat: Warm brown mackerel tabby cat: light warm taupe-brown base, dark espresso narrow M marking centered on forehead, exactly two short curved dark cheek stripes per side, exactly three tapered dark back/flank stripes, three dark tail rings and dark tail tip. Ivory muzzle bib belly and toes remain. All stripe boundaries follow anatomy, same count and location every pose. Pink nose and inner ears; retain black eyes.

breeds.name: 奶油猫
breeds.coat: Cream cat: warm pale buttercream coat, softly shaded apricot crown back and tail, ivory muzzle bib belly paws and tailtip. No stripes, no brown/black patches, no sharp geometric bands. Pink nose and inner ears; retain black eyes. Delicate handpainted fur shading rather than flat recolor.

breeds.name: 英短蓝猫
breeds.coat: British blue shorthair: SOLID cool plush slate-blue gray fur everywhere including cheeks chest belly limbs and paws, slight pale blue-gray muzzle highlights but NO white bib or socks, NO stripes or patches. Pink inner ears, charcoal nose, black glossy eyes preserved. Subtle silver-blue soft lighting conveys dense coat without changing original body/head shape.

breeds.name: 黑猫
breeds.coat: SOLID black cat: warm charcoal-black plush fur over entire head body paws and tail, no white bib/socks, no stripes or patches. Soft warm graphite highlights keep black contours and face legible; don't fill outline black feature detail into solid black blob. Pink inner ears, tiny muted pink nose, black glossy eyes with highlights preserved.

breeds.name: 白猫
breeds.coat: SOLID white cat: clean warm ivory fur over the entire head body paws and tail. Delicate pale lavender-gray shadows for contour volume, soft cream highlights, NO gray/black/orange patches and NO stripes. Pink nose and pink inner ears, black glossy eyes preserved. Keep rich subtle handpainted shading and crisp original black line art.

breeds.name: 奶牛猫
breeds.coat: Black-and-white cow-pattern cat, strict fixed markings: white base; screen-LEFT ear and connected upper-left temple patch charcoal black, ending smoothly just outside left eye; screen-RIGHT ear all WHITE with pink inner ear; center white blaze and white cheeks muzzle chest belly and ALL paws; one broad rounded charcoal patch on lower visible flank; entire tail charcoal except small white tip. NO orange, NO gray tabby stripes, NO extra spots. Keep this exact ear-side assignment even in turned poses; never mirror markings. Soft handpainted texture.
